# ADR-3115: A10: Internal hostname allow for media proxy 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Internal hostnames expand SSRF reach.

## Decision

Media proxies SHALL NOT grant an internal hostname allow for media proxy 7 (A10-7) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Public suffixes only, with IP validation.
